items.title: Deckers Outdoor Stock Has The Bull Case Changed After Raised Guidance
items.summary: Deckers Outdoor reported second quarter sales of US$1,480.55 million and net income of US$313.14 million. Higher earnings per share and raised full year guidance point to continued confidence in demand across UGG and HOKA. The company highlighted stronger international momentum, particularly in Asia Pacific, while also refreshing board expertise through the appointment of Rati Sahi Levesque to its Audit & Risk Management Committee.
